text_blocks.snippet: A prostate cancer vaccine, like sipuleucel-T (Provenge), is a type of immunotherapy that stimulates the body's immune system to target and attack prostate cancer cells. Unlike vaccines that prevent infection, this type of vaccine is used to treat advanced prostate cancer that is no longer responding to hormone therapy but is causing few or no symptoms.

list.title: Personalized Treatment:
list.snippet: Sipuleucel-T is custom-made for each individual. It involves collecting a patient's white blood cells, which are then modified in a lab to recognize prostate cancer cells and infused back into the patient.

list.title: Targeting Prostate Cancer Cells:
list.snippet: The vaccine aims to activate the patient's immune system to specifically target and destroy prostate cancer cells, particularly those expressing prostatic acid phosphatase (PAP).
